programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Election Day; Pups Save the Bubble Monkeys
programs.desc: When Mayor Humdinger runs for mayor of Adventure Bay, his Mayor Mobile runs out of control; when Ryder and the pups visit Tracker and Carlos in the jungle, a group of monkeys finds itself in sticky bubble trouble.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Freaky Pup-Day; Pups Save a Runaway Mayor
programs.desc: Chase and Chickaletta switch bodies and must learn to work together to return Cap'n Turbot's boat to the bay; Mayor Humdinger creates robotic pants to cheat at the Most Amazing Athlete Contest, but his invention soon goes haywire.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Baby Caribou; Pups Save Luke and His Luke-Alike
programs.desc: When a baby caribou winds up speeding down a mountainside, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the calf and reunite it with its family; when Luke Stars gets blown away in a giant tumbleweed, Digi and Tal make a duplicate which dances out of control.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Space Kitty; Pups Save the Sea Sponges
programs.desc: When Humdinger puts on a cat costume, the Alien Kid mistakes him for a real kitty in need of a home and beams Humdinger into his UFO; after a tiring deep-sea dive, Zuma dozes off and dreams about the life he might have.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Baddies; Pups Save the Yumi Bee
programs.desc: Humdinger, Sid and Sweetie join forces to try and take over the Lookout; Humdinger sabotages Yumi's Bee costume, sending her buzzing out of control.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Alien Grandpa; Pups Save a Lemon-Loving Ducklin
programs.desc: Cap'n Turbot speaks fluent alien while stranded with an Alien Grandpa; a lemon-loving duckling from Yumi's Farm disrupts a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.desc: Toothy, lovable Mr. Crocodile, with his best friend Daisy by his side, navigates the human world in a series of zany adventures.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Land Pirates; Pups Save the Birdwatching Turbots
programs.desc: When pirates Alex, Julia, Julius and Chick-ARR-letta set sail into the desert and become lost, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the land pirates; Cap'n Turbot and Francois chirp for help when a bird-watching contest leaves them up in the air.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Big Truck Pups Stop a Flood
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol uses its new big trucks and the help of new pup pal Al to repair a dam before Adventure Bay is flooded.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Plus a Plucky Chicken; Pups Save a Pet Show
programs.desc: When Humdinger steals Farmer Al's super-powered seeds, Chickaletta joins the PAW Patrol to help stop the mayor's corny plan; when Humdinger steals Katie and Cali's tiaras, it's up to the pups to save their costumes and the pet show.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Director; Pups Save the Super Cows
programs.desc: Francois is directing a video when his camera crane rolls away; all the farm animals go missing from the Super Farm Fair.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Talkative Mini Patrol; Pups Save the History of Adventure Bay
programs.desc: Alex dreams that his Mini Patrol animals can talk; the animals take the Bookmobile on a wild ride; Mayor Humdinger steals the ancient book.
